variants: Não roube das salas de jogo!
Não roube das salas do jogo!

To do so, they have to be lured into the cake extractors where they will vanish. Since it is much easier to kill them, it is advised to begin with the luring part.
variants: * É IMPORTANTE, no entanto, que uma certa quantidade de golems de bolo seja desmontada nas máquinas de extração de bolo. Para fazer isso, eles devem ser atraídos para os extratores de bolo, onde desaparecerão. Como é muito mais fácil matá-los, é aconselhável começar pela parte de atraí-los.

consistency_issues.en: Oh, HE will take revenge on zzizz azzault when you zztep in front of HIZZ fazze!
variants: Oh, ELE vai se vingar de zzizz azzault quando você zztep na frente de HIZZ fazze!
Oh, ELE vai se vingar do zzizz azzault quando você pisar na frente da CARA dele!

consistency_issues.en: In this category I have '{Wound Cleansing}' and '{Cure Poison}'.
variants: Nesta categoria tenho '{Limpeza de feridas}' e '{Curar Veneno}'.
Nesta categoria tenho '{Wound Cleansing}' e '{Cure Poison}'.

consistency_issues.en: In this category I have '{Light}', '{Find Person}' and '{Great Light}'.
variants: Nesta categoria tenho '{Light}', '{Find Person}' e '{Great Light}'.
Nesta categoria tenho '{Luz}', '{Encontrar pessoa}' e '{Grande Luz}'.

consistency_issues.en: Sorry, you aren't a druid either a sorcerer.
variants: Desculpe, você não é nem druida nem feiticeiro.
Desculpe, você não é um druida nem um feiticeiro.

consistency_issues.en: As you wish. Is there something else I can do for you?
variants: Como você deseja. Há algo mais que eu possa fazer por você?
Como você desejar. Há algo mais que eu possa fazer por você?

consistency_issues.en: You decided to help Palimuth, report him your mission.
variants: Você decidiu ajudar Palimuth, informe-o sobre sua missão.
Você decidiu ajudar Palimuth, relate sua missão a ele.

consistency_issues.en: Get back to Azerus and report him your mission.
variants: Volte para Azerus e informe-o sobre sua missão.
Volte para Azerus e relate a ele sua missão.
Peça a Azerus uma missão.
Peça uma missão a Azerus.

consistency_issues.en: You are playing the Peacock Ballad and the portal opens.
variants: Você está tocando Peacock Ballad e o portal se abre.
Você está tocando a Balada do Pavão e o portal se abre.

pl_reference_issues.en: Stonecracker's head was much softer than the stones he threw at you.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Głowa Stonecrackera była znacznie bardziej miękka niż kamienie, którymi w ciebie rzucał.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Stonecracker's head was much softer than the stones he threw at you.

pl_reference_issues.en: You've vanquished the Noxious Spawn and his serpentine heart.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Pokonałeś Trujący Pomiot i jego wężowe serce.
pl_reference_issues.lang: You've vanquished the Noxious Spawn and his serpentine heart.

pl_reference_issues.pl: Stepped na jeden Duży, wielki Palec u nogi, palec

pl_reference_issues.en: You have defeated the wallbreaker and saved the glooth plant.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Pokonałeś burzyciela murów i uratowałeś roślinę glooth.
pl_reference_issues.lang: You have defeated the wallbreaker and saved the glooth plant.

pl_reference_issues.en: Riding a traditional beer barrel from the Orcsoberfest is a once-in-a-lifetime experience. Beer sold separately.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Przejażdżka tradycyjną beczką po piwie z Orcsoberfest to przeżycie jedyne w życiu. Piwo sprzedawane osobno.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Riding a traditional beer barrel from the Orcsoberfest is a once-in-a-lifetime experience. Beer sold separately.

pl_reference_issues.en: The Orcsoberfest is not only known for its traditional food, beer and customs but also fun events and excitement! You took part in all of that and can now truly say: "I survived!"
pl_reference_issues.pl: Orcsoberfest słynie nie tylko z tradycyjnego jedzenia, piwa i zwyczajów, ale także z zabawnych wydarzeń i emocji! Brałeś w tym wszystkim udział i teraz z całą pewnością możesz powiedzieć: „Przeżyłem!”
pl_reference_issues.lang: The Orcsoberfest is not only known for its traditional food, beer and customs but also fun events and excitement! You took part in all of that and can now truly say: "I survived!"

pl_reference_issues.en: You made acquaintance with the Thaian. A strange contemporary with a dark history. No man but a derivate of greed and obsession.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Zaprzyjaźniłeś się z Thaianem. Dziwny współczesny z mroczną historią. Nikt inny, jak tylko pochodna chciwości i obsesji.
pl_reference_issues.lang: You made acquaintance with the Thaian. A strange contemporary with a dark history. No man but a derivate of greed and obsession.

pl_reference_issues.en: You have tamed the ghostly mists to do your bidding. For now ...
pl_reference_issues.pl: Oswoiłeś upiorne mgły, aby spełniły Twoje rozkazy. Na razie...
pl_reference_issues.lang: You have tamed the ghostly mists to do your bidding. For now ...

pl_reference_issues.en: Fear me, monsters! There is some more slaying to come!
pl_reference_issues.pl: Bójcie się mnie, potwory! Przed nami jeszcze więcej morderstw!
pl_reference_issues.lang: Fear me, monsters! There is some more slaying to come!

pl_reference_issues.en: Having hunted and bested them all, you live for the thrill of the hunt!
pl_reference_issues.pl: Po upolowaniu i pokonaniu ich wszystkich żyjesz dla dreszczyku polowania!
pl_reference_issues.lang: Having hunted and bested them all, you live for the thrill of the hunt!

pl_reference_issues.en: Now you are able to wander around Tibia wearing an angst-inducing vestment.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Teraz możesz wędrować po Tibia w szacie wywołującej niepokój.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Now you are able to wander around Tibia wearing an angst-inducing vestment.

pl_reference_issues.en: A true beastmaster learns the language of his animal companions. Now you as well can bolster your unique bond with nature and help preserve the balance of life as a proud falconer.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Prawdziwy władca bestii uczy się języka swoich zwierzęcych towarzyszy. Teraz i Ty możesz wzmocnić swoją wyjątkową więź z naturą i pomóc zachować równowagę w życiu jako dumny sokolnik.
pl_reference_issues.lang: A true beastmaster learns the language of his animal companions. Now you as well can bolster your unique bond with nature and help preserve the balance of life as a proud falconer.

pl_reference_issues.en: Champion of the wildlands, a swift strider among the creatures of the wild. The elegant nature of the gallop, this envoy of speed has mastered, indicates the precise understanding of its terrain and environment.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Czempion dziczy, szybki wędrowiec wśród dzikich stworzeń. Elegancki charakter galopu, który opanował ten wysłannik prędkości, wskazuje na dokładne zrozumienie terenu i otoczenia.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Champion of the wildlands, a swift strider among the creatures of the wild. The elegant nature of the gallop, this envoy of speed has mastered, indicates the precise understanding of its terrain and environment.

pl_reference_issues.en: Adventurous beyond death, you travelled the Netherworld. Although you had just the ghost of a chance you survived and even came back from the realm of the dead.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Poszukiwany przygód poza śmiercią, podróżowałeś po zaświatach. Chociaż miałeś cień szansy, przeżyłeś, a nawet wróciłeś z krainy umarłych.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Adventurous beyond death, you travelled the Netherworld. Although you had just the ghost of a chance you survived and even came back from the realm of the dead.

pl_reference_issues.en: If a pride of lions and a pack of hyaenas feud, it is not called a catfight but a ... whatsoever. For sure, it caused a lot of drama in the Darama Desert.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Jeśli stado lwów i stado hien toczą konflikt, nie nazywa się to walką kotów, ale... czymkolwiek. Na pewno wywołało to wiele dramatyzmu na pustyni Darama.
pl_reference_issues.lang: If a pride of lions and a pack of hyaenas feud, it is not called a catfight but a ... whatsoever. For sure, it caused a lot of drama in the Darama Desert.

pl_reference_issues.en: Made acquaintance with three brothers Fitz.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Zrobiony znajomy z trzy brat Fitz.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Made acquaintance with three brothers Fitz.

pl_reference_issues.en: You bested the maleficent duo Drume and Fugue and restored order to the besieged town of Bounac. You conquered the exotic stronghold of the Order of the Cobra and bested the undead knights of the Order of the Falcon. A true knight in heart and mind.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Pokonałeś złowrogi duet Drume i Fugue i przywróciłeś porządek w oblężonym mieście Bounac. Podbiłeś egzotyczną twierdzę Zakonu Cobra i pokonałeś nieumarłych rycerzy Zakonu Sokoła. Prawdziwy rycerz sercem i umysłem.
pl_reference_issues.lang: You bested the maleficent duo Drume and Fugue and restored order to the besieged town of Bounac. You conquered the exotic stronghold of the Order of the Cobra and bested the undead knights of the Order of the Falcon. A true knight in heart and mind.

pl_reference_issues.en: Brought back to the realm of the living this magnificent creature will carry you through death and everything that lays beyond.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Sprowadzone z powrotem do królestwa żywych, to wspaniałe stworzenie przeprowadzi cię przez śmierć i wszystko, co leży poza nią.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Brought back to the realm of the living this magnificent creature will carry you through death and everything that lays beyond.

pl_reference_issues.en: Brought back to the realm of the living this magnificent creature will carry you through death and everything that lays beyond.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Sprowadzone z powrotem do królestwa żywych, to wspaniałe stworzenie przeprowadzi cię przez śmierć i wszystko, co leży poza nią.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Brought back to the realm of the living this magnificent creature will carry you through death and everything that lays beyond.

pl_reference_issues.en: You defeated the manifestation of Goshnar's evil traits by fighting your way through beasts you didn't even want to imagine. It transformed you and now you can also look the part.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Pokonałeś przejawy złych cech Goshnara, walcząc z bestiami, których nawet nie chciałeś sobie wyobrazić. To cię zmieniło i teraz możesz także wyglądać jak należy.
pl_reference_issues.lang: You defeated the manifestation of Goshnar's evil traits by fighting your way through beasts you didn't even want to imagine. It transformed you and now you can also look the part.

pl_reference_issues.en: You helped Domizian and thus proved yourself worthy to enter the werelion sanctum underneath Lion's Rock. You faced the mighty werelions there and one of the rare white lions even chose to accompany you.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Pomogłeś Domizianowi i tym samym udowodniłeś, że jesteś godny wejścia do sanktuarium lwów pod spodem Lion's Rock. Stawiłeś tam czoła potężnym lwołakom, a jeden z rzadkich białych lwów zdecydował się nawet ci towarzyszyć.
pl_reference_issues.lang: You helped Domizian and thus proved yourself worthy to enter the werelion sanctum underneath Lion's Rock. You faced the mighty werelions there and one of the rare white lions even chose to accompany you.

pl_reference_issues.en: When in Rascacoon, do as the Rascoohans do!
pl_reference_issues.pl: Będąc w Rascacoon, rób to, co robią Rascoohanie!
pl_reference_issues.lang: When in Rascacoon, do as the Rascoohans do!

pl_reference_issues.en: Riding around on this squishy companion gives you the feeling of flying through the air... uhm... swimming through the seven seas!
pl_reference_issues.pl: Jazda na tym miękkim towarzyszu daje wrażenie latania w powietrzu... uhm... płynięcia przez siedem mórz!
pl_reference_issues.lang: Riding around on this squishy companion gives you the feeling of flying through the air... uhm... swimming through the seven seas!

pl_reference_issues.en: You are not exactly the Pied Piper of Hamelin but at least you managed to fend off a decent amount of pirats and helped to keep them out of the cities.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Nie jesteś dokładnie Flecistą z Hamelin, ale przynajmniej udało ci się odeprzeć przyzwoitą liczbę piratów i pomogłeś utrzymać ich z dala od miast.
pl_reference_issues.lang: You are not exactly the Pied Piper of Hamelin but at least you managed to fend off a decent amount of pirats and helped to keep them out of the cities.

pl_reference_issues.en: You defeated Megasylvan Yselda in the wake of the sleeping carnisylvan menace deep under Bounac.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Pokonałeś Megasylvana Yseldę w obliczu śpiącego zagrożenia Karnisylvan głęboko pod Bounac.
pl_reference_issues.lang: You defeated Megasylvan Yselda in the wake of the sleeping carnisylvan menace deep under Bounac.

pl_reference_issues.en: Yselda forever stands watch against the carnisylvan menace. Ever awake, waiting in the dark, her heart longs to be united with her king once again. Deep empathy let a hero to bring her Kesar's tulip as a token of his love. That hero was you.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Yselda na zawsze stoi na straży przed zagrożeniem karnawału. Zawsze przebudzona, czekając w ciemności, jej serce pragnie ponownie zjednoczyć się z królem. Głęboka empatia pozwoliła bohaterowi przynieść jej tulipana Kesara na znak swojej miłości. Tym bohaterem byłeś ty.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Yselda forever stands watch against the carnisylvan menace. Ever awake, waiting in the dark, her heart longs to be united with her king once again. Deep empathy let a hero to bring her Kesar's tulip as a token of his love. That hero was you.

pl_reference_issues.en: Your thirst for knowledge is insatiable. In the task of helping your gnomish friends, flawless execution is just the icing on the cake.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Twój pragnienie dla kNiewledge jest nieposkromiony, nienasycony. W the zadanie, zajęcie z porcja twój gNiemish przyjaciel, dobry kolega, kolega, nieskazitelny egzekucja jest just the polewa, lukier na the ciasto, ciastko.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Your thirst for knowledge is insatiable. In the task of helping your gnomish friends, flawless execution is just the icing on the cake.

pl_reference_issues.en: It was not the first time that you helped the Sapphire Blade or the Midnight Flame with a difficult task. You may now wear the Kilmareshian robes as well as the tagralt blade and the eye-embroidered veil of the seers as a sign of Issavi's gratitude.
pl_reference_issues.pl: To nie był pierwszy raz, kiedy pomogłeś Szafirowemu Ostrzu lub Północnemu Płomieniu w trudnym zadaniu. Możesz teraz nosić szaty Kilmareshian, a także ostrze tagralt i haftowaną zasłonę na oczach widzących jako znak wdzięczności Issavi.
pl_reference_issues.lang: It was not the first time that you helped the Sapphire Blade or the Midnight Flame with a difficult task. You may now wear the Kilmareshian robes as well as the tagralt blade and the eye-embroidered veil of the seers as a sign of Issavi's gratitude.

pl_reference_issues.en: Your continued efforts in keeping Bounac and the people of Kesar the Younger safe, earned you a permanent place at the royal court as an advisor to the king.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Twoje nieustające wysiłki na rzecz zapewnienia bezpieczeństwa Bounac i ludu Kesara Młodszego zapewniły ci stałe miejsce na dworze królewskim jako doradca króla.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Your continued efforts in keeping Bounac and the people of Kesar the Younger safe, earned you a permanent place at the royal court as an advisor to the king.

pl_reference_issues.en: Since it is fireproof, this flaming creature feels right at home in raging infernos. But remember: just because it doesn't burn, you still do!
pl_reference_issues.pl: Ponieważ jest ognioodporne, to płonące stworzenie czuje się jak w domu w szalejących piekłach. Ale pamiętaj: tylko dlatego, że się nie pali, nadal palisz!
pl_reference_issues.lang: Since it is fireproof, this flaming creature feels right at home in raging infernos. But remember: just because it doesn't burn, you still do!

pl_reference_issues.en: Equipped with the shell of a tortoise and claws of a lobster this insect like companion will help you through every hardship.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Wyposażony w skorupę żółwia i pazury homara, ten owadopodobny towarzysz pomoże ci przetrwać wszelkie trudności.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Equipped with the shell of a tortoise and claws of a lobster this insect like companion will help you through every hardship.

pl_reference_issues.en: This mighty pachyderm will march into battle as if just taking its Sunday stroll. The cost of friendship was only a few drome points!
pl_reference_issues.pl: Ten potężny pachyderm wyruszy do bitwy, jakby wybierał się na niedzielny spacer. Koszt przyjaźni to tylko kilka punktów dromowych!
pl_reference_issues.lang: This mighty pachyderm will march into battle as if just taking its Sunday stroll. The cost of friendship was only a few drome points!

pl_reference_issues.en: You have braved the searing heat in the tunnels deep below Kazordoon and vanquished the Brainstealer. The voices inside your head are finally silenced.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Stawiłeś czoła palącemu upałowi w tunelach głęboko pod ziemią Kazordoon i pokonałeś Złodzieja Mózgu. Głosy w Twojej głowie w końcu ucichły.
pl_reference_issues.lang: You have braved the searing heat in the tunnels deep below Kazordoon and vanquished the Brainstealer. The voices inside your head are finally silenced.

pl_reference_issues.en: Congratulations to your very first achievement! ... Well, not really. But imagine, it is. Because at this point during your journey into Tibia's past, achievements have been introduced.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Gratulujemy pierwszego osiągnięcia! ... No cóż, niezupełnie. Ale wyobraźcie sobie, że tak jest. Ponieważ w tym momencie twojej podróży do przeszłości Tibia zostały wprowadzone osiągnięcia.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Congratulations to your very first achievement! ... Well, not really. But imagine, it is. Because at this point during your journey into Tibia's past, achievements have been introduced.

pl_reference_issues.en: Just everyone will be crazy about you if you are wearing this formal dress. They will come running, promise!
pl_reference_issues.pl: Po prostu wszyscy będą za tobą szaleć, jeśli założysz tę formalną sukienkę. Przybiegną, obiecuję!
pl_reference_issues.lang: Just everyone will be crazy about you if you are wearing this formal dress. They will come running, promise!

pl_reference_issues.en: This glooth-driven locomotive will bring you to any party in the blink of an eye.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Ta lokomotywa napędzana gloothem w mgnieniu oka przeniesie Cię na każdą imprezę.
pl_reference_issues.lang: This glooth-driven locomotive will bring you to any party in the blink of an eye.

pl_reference_issues.en: You mastered the fire and tamed a supervulcano!
pl_reference_issues.lang: You mastered the fire and tamed a supervulcano!

pl_reference_issues.en: Alas! What could be more beautiful and satisfying than bringing two loving hearts together? So romantic!
pl_reference_issues.pl: Niestety! Co może być piękniejszego i satysfakcjonującego niż połączenie dwóch kochających serc? Tak romantycznie!
pl_reference_issues.lang: Alas! What could be more beautiful and satisfying than bringing two loving hearts together? So romantic!

pl_reference_issues.en: You really were as busy as a beaver in order to help the nagas. Enjoy some eager company!
pl_reference_issues.pl: Naprawdę byłeś zajęty jak bóbr, żeby pomóc nagom. Ciesz się chętnym towarzystwem!
pl_reference_issues.lang: You really were as busy as a beaver in order to help the nagas. Enjoy some eager company!

pl_reference_issues.en: Mysterious nagas, a vibrant jungle and a sinking island - you really know every corner of Marapur now.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Tajemnicze nagi, tętniąca życiem dżungla i tonąca wyspa – teraz naprawdę znasz każdy zakątek Marapur.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Mysterious nagas, a vibrant jungle and a sinking island - you really know every corner of Marapur now.

pl_reference_issues.en: For some it can't be hazardous enough.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Dla niektórych nie może to być wystarczająco niebezpieczne.
pl_reference_issues.lang: For some it can't be hazardous enough.

pl_reference_issues.en: Step by step you discovered many of the secrets hidden in the world, thus gaining the right to wear the Discoverer outfit and hat. Made-to-measure for a brave traveller of the Tibian wilds.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Krok po kroku odkrywałeś wiele tajemnic ukrytych w świecie, zyskując tym samym prawo do noszenia stroju i kapelusza Odkrywcy. Stworzony na miarę dla odważnego podróżnika po tibijskich dziczy.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Step by step you discovered many of the secrets hidden in the world, thus gaining the right to wear the Discoverer outfit and hat. Made-to-measure for a brave traveller of the Tibian wilds.

pl_reference_issues.en: Don't get carried away by your success. Get carried away by your Ripptor.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Nie daj się zwieść swojemu sukcesowi. Daj się ponieść swojemu Ripptorowi.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Don't get carried away by your success. Get carried away by your Ripptor.

pl_reference_issues.en: Combining unabating courage in combat and respect for the traditions and culture of the ancient Iks earned you the honours of true Aucar.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Połączenie niesłabnącej odwagi w walce z szacunkiem dla tradycji i kultury starożytnych Ików zapewniło ci zaszczyty prawdziwego Aucara.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Combining unabating courage in combat and respect for the traditions and culture of the ancient Iks earned you the honours of true Aucar.

pl_reference_issues.en: You accomplished the impossible and created 16 mutagens of corresponding colours.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Dokonałeś niemożliwego i stworzyłeś 16 mutagenów o odpowiednich kolorach.
pl_reference_issues.lang: You accomplished the impossible and created 16 mutagens of corresponding colours.

pl_reference_issues.en: Only its rider can love this abomination of a mount.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Tylko jeździec może pokochać tę obrzydliwość wierzchowca.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Only its rider can love this abomination of a mount.

pl_reference_issues.en: You defeated the embodiments of decay and live to tell the tale, wear the rotting attire of the unfaltering defender proudly.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Pokonałeś ucieleśnienia rozkładu i żyjesz, aby opowiedzieć tę historię, dumnie nosząc gnijący strój nieustraszonego obrońcy.
pl_reference_issues.lang: You defeated the embodiments of decay and live to tell the tale, wear the rotting attire of the unfaltering defender proudly.

pl_reference_issues.en: Sly as a fox, quiet as a mouse - the perfect mount for a stealthy foray.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Chytry jak lis, cichy jak mysz – idealny wierzchowiec na ukradkową wyprawę.
pl_reference_issues.lang: Sly as a fox, quiet as a mouse - the perfect mount for a stealthy foray.

pl_reference_issues.en: Withstanding both filth and desolation of the rotten darkness that corrupted the very core of this world, you embodied the weapon of purity and light to defy all that was tainted. This spirit will continue guide you on all future paths.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Pokonując zarówno brud, jak i spustoszenie zgniłej ciemności, która zepsuła samo jądro tego świata, ucieleśniałeś broń czystości i światła, aby przeciwstawić się wszystkiemu, co było skażone. Ten duch będzie nadal prowadził Cię na wszystkich przyszłych ścieżkach.

pl_reference_issues.en: The Howling Grotto of Nargor used to be a hideout for criminals in the early days when colonisation just started on the isles. Those criminals were probably the first pirates although is unlikely that they had more than a few fishing boats at their disposal. They built some rooms in the caverns but supposedly they found evidence of prior attempts to use the grotto in some way and some of the caverns seemed to be not natural. For some reasons they were attracted to the lower caves where the howling of the wind was that fierce that people said it could drive a man crazy. Be that as it may, those first pirates were known for their bloodthirst, their frequent infightings and for torturing their prisoners. It is assumed that they all killed themselves in their madness. The grotto is rumoured to be haunted by the ghosts of these pirates and those of their victims - but those are only unconfirmed speculations. Nowadays, nobody knows the treacherous passages through the dangerous reefs to reach the isle of Nargor.
pl_reference_issues.pl: Wyjąca Grota w Nargorze była kryjówką przestępców na początku, kiedy na wyspach dopiero rozpoczęła się kolonizacja. Przestępcy ci byli prawdopodobnie pierwszymi piratami, chociaż jest mało prawdopodobne, aby mieli do dyspozycji więcej niż kilka łodzi rybackich. Zbudowali w jaskiniach kilka pomieszczeń, ale podobno znaleźli dowody wcześniejszych prób wykorzystania groty w jakiś sposób, a niektóre jaskinie wydawały się nienaturalne. Z jakiegoś powodu przyciągały ich niższe jaskinie, gdzie wycie wiatru było tak gwałtowne, że ludzie mówili, że może doprowadzić człowieka do szaleństwa. Tak czy inaczej, ci pierwsi piraci byli znani ze swojej żądzy krwi, częstych walk wewnętrznych i torturowania więźniów. Zakłada się, że wszyscy w swoim szaleństwie popełnili samobójstwo. Krążą pogłoski, że grotę nawiedzają duchy tych piratów i ich ofiar – są to jednak tylko niepotwierdzone spekulacje. W dzisiejszych czasach nikt nie zna zdradliwych przejść przez niebezpieczne rafy, które prowadzą na wyspę Nargor.
pl_reference_issues.lang: The Howling Grotto of Nargor used to be a hideout for criminals in the early days when colonisation just started on the isles. Those criminals were probably the first pirates although is unlikely that they had more than a few fishing boats at their disposal. They built some rooms in the caverns but supposedly they found evidence of prior attempts to use the grotto in some way and some of the caverns seemed to be not natural. For some reasons they were attracted to the lower caves where the howling of the wind was that fierce that people said it could drive a man crazy. Be that as it may, those first pirates were known for their bloodthirst, their frequent infightings and for torturing their prisoners. It is assumed that they all killed themselves in their madness. The grotto is rumoured to be haunted by the ghosts of these pirates and those of their victims - but those are only unconfirmed speculations. Nowadays, nobody knows the treacherous passages through the dangerous reefs to reach the isle of Nargor.
